description: This file defines a Java class 'BodyCachingHttpServletRequestWrapper' that extends HttpServletRequestWrapper to cache the request body for multiple reads, including an inner class 'CachedBodyServletInputStream' for input stream handling.

classes.name: BodyCachingHttpServletRequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletRequest that caches the request body for repeated access.

classes.name: CachedBodyServletInputStream
classes.description: An inner class extending ServletInputStream to read from the cached request body.

methods.name: BodyCachingHttpServletRequestWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that reads and caches the request body input stream.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream that reads from the cached body.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader for the cached request body.

methods.name: resetStream
methods.description: Resets the input stream to the start of the cached body.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Checks if the input stream has been fully read.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Indicates the stream is ready for reading.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a byte from the input stream.
